candidates.title: Uncovered texts reveal alleged gun-for-hire network tied to attempted Project South hit
candidates.description: Court documents filed by Crown prosecutors say the alleged hit on a jail official that triggered the police corruption and organized crime case known as Project South was organized by suspects contracting out the job using aliases on an encrypted messaging platform.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: ‘I just wanted to get out of there': Edmonton transit riders report drug use, assaults
candidates.description: The City of Edmonton has been trying to improve safety on public transit for years, hiring more peace and police officers, expanding outreach teams and spending more on cleaning and security upgrades. However, text messages sent to the line over the course of one month earlier this year suggest many riders are still concerned about safety on the system.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Demand for Canadian citizenship certificates soaring, fuelled by Americans
candidates.description: Applications from people around the world seeking Canadian citizenship certificates have been rising rapidly, fuelled by thousands from the United States, CBC News has learned. So many people have applied following a change in the law that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada says those who apply today could have to wait more than two years for a decision.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Grizzly bear escapes enclosure at Calgary Zoo
candidates.description: One-year-old grizzly bear Fitz escaped his enclosure at the Calgary Zoo Sunday morning. The zoo says the bear was safely returned to his enclosure.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Where do Canada-U.S. trade negotiations stand? Here's a sector-by-sector breakdown
candidates.description: Canada is continuing to negotiate a trade deal with the U.S. that will allow it to both avoid U.S. President Donald Trump's crippling tariff threat — set to come into effect on Wednesday — and get some additional relief on existing tariffs in key sectors.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian enriched uranium shipped to Canadian-owned Westinghouse in U.S.
candidates.description: While the Russian military attacks Ukraine's power infrastructure, Europe and the U.S. still depend on Russian nuclear fuel to power their electricity grids. Canadian-owned Westinghouse Electric is among the companies that receive low enriched uranium from Russia to fuel commercial nuclear reactors in the U.S., shipping data analyzed by the fifth estate shows.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Manitoba pork producers bring trade pitch to Iowa fair amid Canada-U.S. tariff tensions
candidates.description: Pork is a popular topic at the Iowa State Fair as hungry patrons chow down on barbecue and curious children gaze with wide eyes at the state's biggest pig.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Meet Finn, the 15-year-old who saved a shark in New Brunswick
candidates.description: “When we saw it, it looked really hurt, it almost looked dead," says Finn Holland. "But then we saw subtle movements.”
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sea Bears show 'you can do it from Winnipeg' in first Canadian Elite Basketball League championship win
candidates.description: An explosion of cheers erupted at Canada Life Centre Saturday evening as Winnipegger Simon Hildebrandt hit the shot of a lifetime.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: An Acadian flag emoji? Online petition gathers thousands of signatures
candidates.description: Alexis Belliveau and Julien Robichaud are submitting an application for the creation of an Acadian flag emoji to the organization that reviews and approves emojis. Their online petition launched Tuesday has garnered over 10,000 signatures.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Carney, Wakeham, Fréchette will meet in St. John's as provinces inch toward new deal on Churchill Falls energy
candidates.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney, Newfoundland and Labrador Premier Tony Wakeham and Quebec Premier Christine Fréchette are meeting in St. John's on Monday for "an announcement regarding energy security and economic development."
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'It was unbearable': Halifax tenants call for indoor temperature cap
candidates.description: A recent heat wave has forced tenants to find ways to survive the high temperatures. Some believe the government should limit allowable indoor temperatures for rental units and offer financial aids for cooling methods.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Toxic algae outbreaks in Alberta can now be tracked online through satellite imagery
candidates.description: Blue-green algae is being monitored by researchers across Alberta, and the public can follow along from anywhere through a new website. The Algal Bloom Tracker lets users track toxic algal blooms at six Alberta lakes through satellite imagery, providing near real-time results that can be viewed on a free-to-use map.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Canadian men's flag football team earns ticket to LA 2028, where sport will make its Olympics debut
candidates.description: Canada's women's flag football team beat the United States for the world title, while men's squad booked its place at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics on Sunday at the International Federation of American Football (IFAF) world championships in Düsseldorf, Germany.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ontario city needs action on copper wire theft, says frustrated home builder
candidates.description: Allen Wu admits he was naive about what can happen to home building sites in Windsor. But now that his student housing project has been struck by vandals and thieves four times this summer, he and his partners are wondering how such crime is allowed to persist.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
candidates.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: B.C. mayor calls for gang task force support after surge in targeted shootings
candidates.description: Fort St. John Mayor Lilia Hansen wants B.C.'s gang task force to intervene after three shootings in less than a month near local schools.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Consensus reached on proposed corridor for road connecting Nunavut and N.W.T.
candidates.description: The agreement is a step forward towards creating Canada’s first land-based link to Nunavut’s Arctic coast, providing an opportunity for year-round road access to Wekweètì and Gamètì.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.S. Supreme Court again rejects Trump's effort to overturn E. Jean Carroll verdict
candidates.description: A top U.S. court has declined to reconsider a June decision rejecting U.S. President Donald Trump's appeal of a $5-million US verdict in favour of E. Jean Carroll. A jury in 2023 found Trump liable for sexually abusing and defaming the former magazine columnist.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Indonesia quake death toll rises to 68, thousands left homeless
candidates.description: Thousands of people were still waiting for aid on the Indonesian island of Flores on Monday, days after a powerful earthquake killed at least 68 people, injured more than 200 others and damaged hundreds of homes and other buildings.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cristiano Ronaldo hints at retirement after 25 years in pro soccer
candidates.description: Cristiano Ronaldo says this Saudi Pro League season is likely to be the last of his professional career.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Belgian wildfire approaches Germany despite rain as Greece probes deadly blaze
candidates.description: One of Belgium's biggest-ever wildfires blazed out of control Monday even as cooler weather and rain eased conditions for firefighters, while in Greece a fire briefly flared up near the main airport on the outskirts of Athens.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How Iowans feel about Trump's tariffs, Canada's treatment as Republicans vie for support
candidates.description: Much like the Calgary Stampede in Canada, the Iowa State Fair is a crucial stop for politicians to meet voters, making it a hotbed for political debates — especially when U.S. midterms are coming up. And this year, one of the topics on Iowans' minds is U.S. President Donald Trump's trade war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump orders joint military exercises with South Korea to be scaled back
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump ordered the Pentagon on Sunday to scale back planned joint military exercises with South Korea, saying it declined to help denuclearize Iran and citing his good relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong-un.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lala drenches, lashes Hawaii despite weakening to tropical storm
candidates.description: Hurricane Lala weakened to a tropical storm on Sunday after its eyewall skirted Hawaii without making landfall. But it continued to punish the state with hurricane-force gusts and pounding rain, reaching a total of nearly one metre in places and sending raging torrents down mountain slopes.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak is now the deadliest in its history
candidates.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 2,325 people, government data showed on Sunday, surpassing the toll from the 2018-2020 outbreak to become the deadliest in the country's history. The D.R.C.'s public health institute said in its latest report that confirmed cases had risen to ‌4,945.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Driver in custody after bus in Hungary crashes into ditch, killing 12 and injuring at least 10
candidates.description: A passenger bus carrying Polish tourists on a highway in Hungary went off the road and into a ditch where it overturned, killing a dozen people and injuring at least 10 early Sunday, police said. The bus was travelling on eastbound lanes near Mezokeresztes around 140 kilometres east of Budapest.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: They own 2 excavators in Gaza and can't keep up with demand as families dig for remains
candidates.description: As the search for remains continues in Gaza, officials on the ground say there's a serious lack of heavy machinery like excavators to speed up the process of digging through the rubble. One family that owns two of the machines says the high cost of fuel and oil, and the lack of spare parts for maintenance, means they can't keep up with the demand for their services.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hundreds of migrants in Spain's Ceuta enclave protest for asylum, against deportation to Morocco
candidates.description: Hundreds of migrants who recently entered Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta staged a protest on a popular urban beach on Sunday, urging Spanish authorities to grant them asylum instead of sending them back to Morocco.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: At least 2 people killed as firefighters battle massive wildfires in Greece, Belgium
candidates.description: Firefighters battled a massive wildfire that scorched a nature reserve in eastern Belgium and another on a Greek island near Athens, where two people were killed on Sunday as hot and dry conditions fuelled fires across parts of Europe.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tommy John, pitcher who won 288 games and underwent groundbreaking surgery, dead at 83
candidates.description: Tommy John, who won 288 games during a 26-year big league career and became the first pitcher to successfully return following groundbreaking elbow surgery that later was named after him, has died. He was 83.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Thousands evacuated as Indonesia quake death toll rises to 53
candidates.description: Thousands of people have been evacuated after a magnitude-7.7 earthquake hit eastern Indonesia, killing at least 53 people, blocking roads and causing landslides.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump dismisses reports of grim conditions on U.S. aircraft carrier
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump dismissed reports of grim conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, an aircraft carrier currently in the Middle East that has now been deployed at sea for more than 260 days.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Antonello da Messina artworks stolen from museum in Italy
candidates.description: Three panels from ‌Polittico di San Gregorio altarpiece and a separate painting depicting the Virgin with Child were taken from the Museo Regionale di Messina in the 15th-century painter's hometown.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Inflation rate rose to 3% in July as gas prices climbed again
candidates.description: The resumption of hostilities in the Middle East in July sent gas pump prices back up, after a brief ceasefire cooled them in June. Inflation for food bought from stores cooled in July, with fresh vegetable and chicken prices driving the decline.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: What's at stake as Meta faces potential landmark trial in U.S. federal court
candidates.description: Meta has lost two trials concerning child safety on its platforms so far this year and settled a third case. The company now faces what could be its most consequential trial yet, in federal court beginning Tuesday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Why is Australian beef the cheaper option in Canadian grocery stores?
candidates.description: Australian beef is on supermarket shelves across Saskatchewan now, and the prices are much lower than for Canadian beef.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
candidates.description: The US and Oman have been working separately to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's busiest oil shipping routes.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
candidates.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is seeking to gain Israeli backing for the US-backed Gaza peace plan.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Supreme Court again rejects Trump's bid to overturn E Jean Carroll sex abuse case
candidates.description: The US president has already paid the writer over $5m in damages in the assault and defamation case.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
candidates.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Ferrari's first ever electric car sold for record $40m
candidates.description: The Luce's launch drew backlash from some commentators who said it broke from the brand's signature dramatic styling.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Record rains drench South Korean city as landslide kills one
candidates.description: It comes as large swathes of East and South East Asia have been pummelled by dats of heavy rain.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Teen suspect in Virginia campus shooting found hiding in closet
candidates.description: The attack left five injured outside a halls of residence, and the suspect was not a student there, say police.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Thailand has a gun problem - 10 million of them
candidates.description: Recent shootings have highlighted the country's troubled relationship with guns, with laws doing little to curb the violence.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: 'I want my brother back' - Tupac’s brother tells BBC murder trial won’t bring justice
candidates.description: The BBC's Shaimaa Khalil sat down with Mopreme Shakur ahead of the trial for his brother and late rapper's 1996 murder.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Why is Australia's mushroom killer back in court this week?
candidates.description: The BBC’s Katy Watson explains why triple-murderer Erin Patterson is back in court this week trying to overturn her conviction.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Instagram and Facebook could change forever if Meta loses child privacy trial
candidates.description: US states are suing the social media giant to force an overhaul of its platforms for young users.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: I survived two years as prime minister in a hit new game - then my cabinet deserted me
candidates.description: Mobile game No 10: Full Confidence recently ranked above Minecraft on the UK App Store paid games chart
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Flash flood sweeps vehicle away in Hawaii after Hurricane Lala
candidates.description: Tropical storm warnings remain for some of the state's islands, as the storm is due to progress west.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Muir resignation demand is 'not personal' says UFU
candidates.description: The Ulster Farmers' Union rejects a claim that it is trying to dictate policy after a cattle cull.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: About 100 homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
candidates.description: The state's governor says there "amazingly" does not seem to have been any loss of life besides a car crash.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: USS Washington to relieve USS Lincoln. And, Jared Kushner to meet with Netanyahu
candidates.description: The USS Washington is on its way to the Middle East to relieve the USS Lincoln amid concerns about conditions aboard. And, Jared Kushner is expected to meet with Prime Minister Netanyahu to move Gaza talks forward.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: At least 6 dead after Ukraine launches aerial attack on Russia
candidates.description: Ukraine launched one of its largest aerial attacks of the war on Russia, killing at least six people. How are Russians feeling as the war grinds on?
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: As war with Ukraine wages on, a look at life inside Russia
candidates.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Nina Krushcheva, professor of international affairs at the New School, about the current geopolitical climate in Russia.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Trump orders Pentagon to scale back joint exercises with South Korea
candidates.description: President Trump explained the decision by saying South Korea had declined to help with the "denuclearization" of Iran and he cited his good relationship with North Korea's leader.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Kushner meets with Hamas on the Gaza road map ahead of talks with Netanyahu
candidates.description: Jared Kushner, President Trump's son-in-law, held a rare meeting with Hamas leadership Sunday in Egypt, in a new diplomatic effort to make progress in the stalled Gaza ceasefire.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: A good – and bad – week for Italy's art police and museum security
candidates.description: On Friday, Italian police said they'd recovered three paintings stolen from a museum near the city of Parma. By Saturday night, thieves in Sicily had made off with four more masterpieces.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: What really happened in Ceuta? Why we may never find out
candidates.description: Hundreds of migrants have again attempted to cross from Morocco into the Spanish territory of Ceuta. This time, Moroccan officials fended them off, raising new questions about the crossing of July 30.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
candidates.description: Ukraine launched hundreds of drones across Russia Sunday, killing at least six people in one of Kyiv's largest aerial attacks of the war.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Families of USS Lincoln crew say Trump should be 'ashamed' of conditions on board
candidates.description: President Trump said the USS Abraham Lincoln deployment is "not nearly long enough." A family member of a sailor on board that ship said those comments are shameful.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Jason Arday, Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism, is found dead
candidates.description: Arday was 37 when he became Cambridge's youngest Black professor in 2023. He was found unresponsive Friday at a home in southwest London.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Living with nuns: Priced out of D.C., young women found low rent with unlikely roommates
candidates.description: For 10 years, a Catholic-run home offered young women an affordable place to live in the nation's capital as they studied and launched careers. Now, that community is saying goodbye.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Meta heads to court in a landmark trial about kids and social media addiction
candidates.description: Four states are suing the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, alleging that the platforms were designed to hook kids and that Meta hid the mental health risks.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Missed shifts were costly to this McDonald's. An app has fixed the problem
candidates.description: Unexpected absences can cost employers tens of thousands of dollars a month. An app that helps workers with last-minute transportation, food and childcare is making a difference.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.S. oil reserves hit the lowest level seen in over 40 years
candidates.description: NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben speaks with Kevin Book of ClearView Energy about the United States' dwindling oil reserves as they hit the lowest level seen in more than four decades.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Companies are getting tariff refunds of up to $2 billion from the Trump administration
candidates.description: NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben speaks to Wall Street Journal business reporter Theo Francis about refunds some businesses are getting on the billions of dollars they've paid on President Trump's tariffs.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Cialis is an erectile dysfunction drug. Could it also help you live longer?
candidates.description: In some wellness circles, tadalafil is promoted as a longevity drug. There is evidence showing a link between it and a lower risk of death in men, but there are no well-controlled trials in humans.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 'What are we going to do?' The mom of a trans teen grapples with Trump's Medicaid move
candidates.description: A longtime Republican living in California says the Trump administration's continuing actions to target transgender youth take a personal toll.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Lindsay Clancy's trial highlights gaps in understanding, treating postpartum psychosis
candidates.description: The high-profile murder trial of Lindsay Clancy's has put the condition in the spotlight. Women who have had it call for more research and understanding of a difficult mental illness.
candidates.author: NPR
